in_marathi.name: Rajat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rajat is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rajata' which means 'Silver' or 'Shining'. It is a name for boys that signifies wealth, prosperity, and royalty. In Hindu mythology, silver is considered as a sacred metal and is often used in religious ceremonies and rituals.
